summary: Vigo's central-area parking policy is moving toward restriction: the Low Emission Zone ordinance (four zones: Centro, Praza de Portugal, Calvario, Bouzas) was definitively approved on 27 July 2026, with warnings only in the first year and fines of up to 200 euros after. Street parking is regulated by the zona azul (XER), whose published rates are 0.60 euros per hour and 1.45 euros for the two-hour maximum, with resident cards, while pedestrian and Vigo Vertical works are removing some surface spaces. Off-street supply mixes Empark's Praza de Portugal concession, Zona Franca-run car parks (Praza da Estrela, A Laxe) and shopping-centre car parks such as Vialia, with new capacity planned at Barrio do Cura (302 spaces) and ETEA. Demand peaks come from the Christmas lights (record December hotel occupancy in 2024, a maximum-restriction mobility plan in 2025) and cruise calls (119 planned for 2026); Vitrasa is proposed to keep the city bus contract to 2036.

items.text: On 27 July 2026 the Vigo plenary definitively approved the ordinance creating Low Emission Zones (ZBE) in four areas: Centro, Praza de Portugal, Bouzas and Calvario. It passed with PSOE votes only (PP and BNG against). Restrictions are phased: vehicles without an environmental label first, then label B, then label C; fines of up to 200 euros; entry into force expected within about two months of publication and processing of access authorisations. Exemptions include residents and business owners in the zones, public services, taxis and buses.
items.source_title: Vigo da luz verde a sus Zonas de Bajas Emisiones: cuatro áreas, restricciones progresivas y multas de hasta 200 euros

items.text: Merca2 reports the approved Vigo ZBE covers 67.18 hectares (about 0.6% of the municipal area) and affects about 62,100 vehicles registered in Vigo with no environmental label or label B or C. The fine is 200 euros; during the first year only informative notices are sent, with fines applying from year two.
items.source_title: Vigo aprueba su Zona de Bajas Emisiones: multas de 200 euros y restricciones para 62.100 coches sin etiqueta, B y C

items.text: Vigo's regulated on-street parking (zona azul/XER) runs Monday to Friday 9:00-14:00 and 16:00-20:00, free at weekends and holidays. Non-residents pay from 0.30 euros (minimum 33 minutes) up to 1.45 euros for the 120-minute maximum; residents with the XER card have no time limit and pay 0.35 euros per two hours; the resident card costs 98 euros a year (34 euros per quarter).
items.source_title: Zona Azul de Vigo: horario, precio, multas...

items.text: A November 2025 guide to Christmas parking in Vigo gives zona azul prices of 0.60 euros for one hour and 1.45 euros for two hours (the maximum), operating 9-14h and 16-20h on weekdays and free at weekends and holidays, i.e. the same rates as listed in 2023. It lists central car parks mostly at 2 to 2.88 euros per hour, Centro Comercial A Laxe at 1.29 euros per hour after 30 free minutes, and the Areal car park at 1.98 euros per hour.
items.source_title: Dónde aparcar en Navidad en Vigo: parkings, zona azul y gratuito

items.text: The Concello de Vigo converted an informal free parking area in front of the old railway station, at the access to the Vialia car park and taxi zone, into a 'kiss and go' passenger drop-off zone with a 15-minute maximum stop. The Concello acted because users had been using the space to avoid parking fees and blue-zone time limits.
items.source_title: El Concello de Vigo pone fin a una zona de aparcamiento gratis en pleno centro

items.text: Installation of mechanical ramps on Rúa Pintor Colmeiro (Praza da Independencia to Hispanidad) will permanently remove about 20 of the street's roughly 30 surface blue-zone spaces (up to 65%), cutting daytime rotation parking near two health centres, two hospitals and a nursery school. The works are co-financed by the Pontevedra provincial government.
items.source_title: Las obras dejan sin todo su aparcamiento a una calle de Vigo y la mitad se elimina para siempre

items.text: The Concello applied for European FEDER funds for the 'Plan de Actuación Integrado Vigo Vertical Travesas-Castrelos' (estimated cost about 20 million euros, 12 million requested), including mechanical ramps between Praza América and Rúa Tarragona, a bike lane from Praza América to Castrelos and nearly 4 million euros of electric buses. This was a funding application; the article says the EU decision was due on 27 August.
items.source_title: Vigo busca fondos para revolucionar Gran Vía, Travesas y Castrelos: rampas, carril bici y más

items.text: Vigo presented the new urban bus contract: nine years from 2026 (shorter than previous contracts), estimated spend about 468 million euros, with the bidder required to invest 69 million euros. Vitrasa, which has operated the service for decades, was to receive a further extension only until January 2026.
items.source_title: El nuevo contrato del bus urbano de Vigo será por 9 años y desde 2026

items.text: On about 20 July 2026 the contracting committee proposed awarding the new Vigo urban bus contract to Vitrasa (maximum 468.6 million euros over 10 years, to 2036), pending final administrative steps. It replaces the concession model with a service-provision contract, with progressive incorporation of 55 new buses and technology upgrades, keeping the existing route structure.
items.source_title: Vitrasa, a un paso de seguir al frente del autobús urbano de la ciudad hasta 2036

items.text: Vigo reported average hotel occupancy of 82% in December 2024, about 11 points above December 2023, which Mayor Abel Caballero called the best December for hotels in the city's history, driven by the Christmas lights. About 40% of visitors were international, 62% of those from Portugal (municipal data pending INE confirmation).
items.source_title: "Nunca pasó nada igual", se congratula Caballero, tras un diciembre de récord en la Navidad de Vigo

items.text: For Christmas 2025 Vigo activated its highest mobility-restriction level from 10:00 on 28 November to 21:30 on 1 December (also the Constitution Day weekend and 26 December). Intercity coaches get a drop-off/pick-up zone on calle Areal with a 15-minute limit and must park at the Samil beach car parks; Rúa Cervantes becomes one-way descending, and visitors are directed to enter via AP-9 exits.
items.source_title: Navidad 2025: Vigo activa este fin de semana su plan de movilidad para los días de mayor afluencia

items.text: The Concello decided against running shuttle buses from deterrent car parks at Christmas 2025 because of insufficient demand, relying on existing public transport. The Christmas parking guide cites free parking options at Monte O Castro and in Coia (reached on foot or by bus) and Samil beach as a deterrent car park.
items.source_title: Dónde aparcar en Navidad en Vigo: parkings, zona azul y gratuito

items.text: The Port of Vigo scheduled 17 cruise calls in April 2026 and expects 119 calls over the full year, including six calls in under a week in mid/late April (a triple call on 21 April with Le Bellot, Ventura and Britannia, and first calls of Norwegian Sky and Liberty of the Seas).
items.source_title: El Puerto de Vigo se prepara para recibir seis cruceros en menos de siete días

items.text: Empark, concessionaire of the Praza do Portugal car park under a public concession awarded in 2017 (with a full building renovation), was set to raise 2023 tariffs by 3.9% under the concession's price formula (wages, energy, cement, copper). The monthly resident pass rose from 98.03 to 101.73 euros and the concession fee payable to the Concello rose to 126,464 euros a year.
items.source_title: El parking de Praza do Portugal subirá sus tarifas este 2023, aunque por debajo de la inflación

items.text: Telpark (Empark group) lists the Plaza de Portugal car park, Vigo, with 183 car spaces and 10 motorbike spaces on two levels, open 24 hours, with electric charging, express entry by plate recognition, maximum height 185 cm, first hour 1.80 euros and daily maximum 19.90 euros (page undated; seen October 2026).
items.source_title: Plaza de Portugal car park

items.text: The Tribunal Superior de Xustiza de Galicia annulled the 2007 award of two underground-car-park concession lots: Lot 1 (Areal, Pintor Colmeiro, Policarpo Sanz) to UTE Eloymar-Tranvías Eléctricos and Lot 2 (Castelao, Jenaro de la Fuente, Rosalía de Castro) to Puentes y Calzadas, because most spaces (e.g. 67.55% at Policarpo Sanz) did not meet the required 240 cm width. The court excluded the winning bidder but did not order the procedure to be restarted.
items.source_title: Anulan la adjudicación de varios aparcamientos en Vigo por incumplir el tamaño de las plazas

items.text: The Zona Franca de Vigo said the robotised A Laxe car park would be converted to a conventional car park with 184 spaces on two levels (works from 1 September 2022 for about six months, 1.6 million euros), which allowed the concession to be extended from 2025 to 2040. Zona Franca and the Port Authority were also discussing linking it with the Praza da Estrela car park for 400-500 additional spaces.
items.source_title: Las obras del aparcamiento robotizado de A Laxe empezarán en septiembre y acabarán en primavera

items.text: The Praza da Estrela car park (452 spaces, operated by the Consorcio de la Zona Franca de Vigo) added 12 electric-vehicle charging points: eleven 22 kW AC and one 30 kW DC rapid charger, with dynamic power management; users start charging with their parking ticket and pay at the cash machine or payment office.
items.source_title: El aparcamiento de la Praza da Estrela suma doce plazas para recargar vehículos eléctricos

items.text: Vialia Vigo (railway-station shopping centre, opened March 2021 under a 50-year concession held by Ceetrus) announced about 1,600 car-park spaces, an hourly tariff of 0.48 euros from minute 16 then 0.030 euros per minute with a 25 euro daily maximum (first 15 minutes free), and monthly passes of 90 euros (24h), 70 (daytime) and 40 (night).
items.source_title: Vialia Vigo anuncia sus tarifas por hora y precios de abonos del parking

items.text: Vigo's Urbanismo department approved licences for a 302-space public-use car park (four levels, budget about 2.4 million euros) within the Barrio do Cura residential development in central Vigo; 114 of the spaces sit on private parcels with public-use rights.
items.source_title: Vigo completa el avance de Barrio do Cura: Urbanismo da luz verde a las obras de 302 plazas de parking

items.text: Mayor Abel Caballero and the Zona Franca delegate signed an agreement (also involving the Xunta, which contributes 10 million euros) for urbanising area PS-1 of the former ETEA site, including a planned underground car park (number of spaces not given); the delegate said works would start in about a year and last about 18 months.
items.source_title: "Desbloqueada" una demanda histórica en Vigo, hoja de ruta de las nuevas obras en la ETEA

items.text: On 6 October 2026 the Concello signed the purchase of two plots (about 30,000 m2, 80,809 euros paid to the Consorcio de la Zona Franca) at Camiño Borralleiro, Alcabre, next to O Cocho beach, to turn informal beach parking into free parking; no completion date was given.
items.source_title: El Concello pondrá un aparcamiento junto a la playa de Alcabre

items.text: Only 92 private garage spaces were available to rent in central Vigo in February 2025, at an average of 91 euros a month (30 euros for a motorbike in Balaídos to 180 euros for a car on García Olloqui). The article describes Vigo as having Spain's highest vehicle-to-resident ratio and notes pedestrian-oriented urban redesigns reduce street parking.
items.source_title: Las plazas de garaje en el centro de Vigo ya están en 91 euros y no hay ni un centenar disponible
